newsitem.title: POLAND: WBK, AIB set up securities firm.
newsitem.headline: WBK, AIB set up securities firm.

text.p: Allied Irish Banks (AIB) and its Polish partner Wielkopolski Bank Kredytowy SA (WBK) have set up a securities management firm, WBK said in a statement on Thursday.
"On April 4, an agreement was signed on creating a joint-stock company WBK-AIB Asset Management...and its founders are WBK, AIB and a private investor," the statement said.
AIB, which hold a 36.3 percent of shares in WBK, has a 50-percent stake in the new firm, WBK 49.997 percent and a private investor the remainder, it said.
WBK said that it would invest nearly 1.5 million zlotys in the company, which will start operations after it gets an approval from the Securities Commission (KPW).
WBK said that the creation of the firm is part of its earlier agreement with AIB, which also provides for setting up a company to manage investment funds.
AIB has got the Polish central bank's agreement to increase its stake in WBK to 60.2 percent.
